Messages.Author: Harsh Greeting
Messages.Body:
Hi,

can you play the 2nd trad: domain (untap and get +2 intercept) if you
are tapped, but don't need the intercept? (ie: against a zero or 1
stealth action?)

ta,

Harsh.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:


No. You can never give intercept to a reacting minion unless that
minion needs more intercept to match the acting minion's stealth.

(You can give +2 intercept when only 1 intercept is needed - this is
true of any card, not just 2nd tradition).
